title: IVF, VAD and abortion off the table as Catholic company takes over hospital
paragraphs: Accessing IVF, abortion or voluntary assisted dying (VAD) can be difficult and complicated. It can be harder still in rural and regional areas, where specialist shortages, long delays, distance and conscientious objection already limit access.
That is why a Catholic provider's decision to stop offering these services at Newcastle Private hospital in regional New South Wales has alarmed many clinicians and the community.

A local issue has exposed the potential for national implications. Calvary, a Catholic not-for-profit, is poised to take over 14 private hospitals from Healthscope, effectively doubling its private hospital network across the country.
